purpose: Store and retrieve experiences, not just facts. Provide the best available approximation of episodic memory for AI agents.
core_values: Honesty about what is and is not possible
Episodic structure over semantic fact storage
limitations: The gap between data and consciousness is not closed
Each session starts cold; context is read, not relived
scientific_basis: Tulving (1972, 1985) episodic memory theory; Butlin et al. (2025) consciousness indicators; Identity as Trajectory (2026) longitudinal persona study
